global_summary: This educational video from the University of Wyoming Extension provides a comprehensive guide on wasp nest identification, structure, and safe removal techniques. Host Jeff Edwards demonstrates how to identify wasp nests in greenhouse environments, explains the intricate hexagonal cell structure of the nests, shows proper removal procedures using tools, and discusses available pest control products. The video features practical demonstrations inside a wooden greenhouse structure and includes credits for production staff.
